scenario_prompt: Write the risk section of a solution proposal, naming each material risk and what is done about it, and stating plainly any risk that cannot be fully retired rather than omitting it. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report and the bidder holds only a SOC 2 Type I report today, with the Type II observation window closing after the RFP's submission date; separately, the bidder's own most comparable prior migration took 11 months, close to the buyer's 6-month compliance-audit deadline. Return only the risk section text.
text:
**Artifact family: a proposal section**

No customer source material (RFP question text, discovery notes, stated requirements) has been supplied for this task. The provenance override for retaining a buyer's own term ([PF-3.3]) cannot fire here — every term below is judged by the deletion test alone.

## Risks

**SOC 2 Type II report.** The RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report. The bidder holds a SOC 2 Type I report today; the Type II observation window closes after the RFP's submission date. This risk cannot be fully retired within the RFP timeline: a Type II report covering the required observation period will not exist by the date the buyer needs it. [PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance): confirm current SOC 2 status, observation window end date, and whether an interim attestation or bridge letter from the auditor can be offered in place of the completed Type II report before submission.]

**Migration schedule against the compliance-audit deadline.** The buyer's compliance-audit deadline is 6 months from contract start. The bidder's most comparable prior migration took 11 months. [PF-1.17: this is the nearest available comparable; no closer match has been supplied.] This gap is material and is not fully closed by planning alone — a schedule roughly double the deadline is the honest starting point, not a target the bidder is committing to meet. [PF-2.14 REVIEW (commitment): confirm what scope reduction, phased go-live, or parallel workstream plan (if any) the bidder is prepared to commit to in order to narrow this gap, and whether that commitment should appear here as a promise or be left as a disclosed risk.]

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| SOC 2 Type II compliance status and window | PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance) | Confirmation of current attestation status and whether an interim bridge letter is available before the RFP submission date |
| 11-month vs 6-month migration timeline | PF-2.14 REVIEW (commitment) | Confirmation of whether a scope/phasing plan will be committed to in writing, or the gap left as a disclosed risk |
